**Statistical Programming and Reproducible Data Science**  
Advanced Methods and Practical Applications Using Python, R, Stata, and SQL

Download the same free teaching resources for the ebook, paperback and
hardcover. Start with a project, identify its data and expected results,
then run the supplied analytical code in your preferred environment.

<a class="download" href="https://zenodo.org/records/24382209/files/Statistical_Programming_Stage8_Reader_Companion.zip?download=1">Download the complete companion (39.2 MB)</a>

The single ZIP on Zenodo contains all 2,033 companion files and their checksum manifest. Extract it once to use the materials offline. The [Zenodo record](https://zenodo.org/records/24382209) gives the version, citation and reuse terms.

For a smaller download at a time, get [volume 1](Reader_Companion_1.zip) and [volume 2](Reader_Companion_2.zip) from this site. Extract both into the same folder to obtain the same files. All downloads are free.

## What the downloads contain

The companion includes Python and R scripts, Stata do-files, SQL, teaching
datasets, codebooks, assignment worksheets, worked project reports,
verified numerical outputs, logs and reproducibility guides. Every file
has a checksum in the combined package manifest.

Python, R and DuckDB were rerun for the Stage 8 computational review.
Matching outputs from the original licensed Stata runs are retained.
Run new Stata analyses using an installed licensed copy.

The data catalogue distinguishes included teaching datasets from original
provider holdings. Controlled surveys use their custodian's access route;
the teaching baselines include synthetic datasets for the labs.
